answer: Require every agent to carry a chained atlas of its own past work: each epoch it must extend a sequential proof chain seeded from its previous attestation, so a clone cannot copy the chain without also copying the identity key. Forging ten clones means running ten separate sequential puzzles, each costing hours of real compute that cannot be parallelised. Validators replay the chain and reject any break, and an agent that skips a link loses its oasis of earned reputation, leaving only a cold ember of trust to rebuild from scratch.
